note: Bytes of ASCII text per token, and characters beyond ASCII per token, measured on 2026-10-14 through a gateway's usage on 6 000 characters of each kind with the cheapest model of each family: prose, code, JSON and Chinese. Every measure is times a hundred. A structured text (code, JSON, what a command printed) is counted at the middle of code and JSON. A family that was not measured is counted between the two that were.
